title: Return policy
passage: Do I need the receipt to exchange this jacket? A. The reception desk is downstairs. B. A bank statement showing the purchase will also work. C. The jacket comes in three colors.
passageZh:
換這件外套需要收據嗎？
A. 接待櫃檯在樓下。
B. 顯示這筆購買的銀行帳單也可以。
C. 這款外套有三種顏色。
